datasets.title: BLGF Local Government Unit Fiscal Data
datasets.publisher: Bureau of Local Government Finance (BLGF) via BetterGov.ph
datasets.attributionText: Local fiscal data compiled and published by the Bureau of Local Government Finance (BLGF), Department of Finance.
outputs: BLGF — FY 2024 Statement of Receipts and Expenditures by LGU (resource 30)
BLGF — FY 2024 Annual Regular Income and Dependencies by LGU (resource 31)
BLGF — FY 2024 Special Education Fund Income and Expenditures (resource 44)
BLGF — FY 2024 Local Disaster Risk Reduction Management Fund by LGU (resource 41)
datasets.notes: Four per-LGU workbooks, one row selected for Labo, Camarines Norte. sha256 is of the Statement of Receipts and Expenditures workbook; bytes is the combined download size.

datasets.title: DPWH Infrastructure Transparency Dataset
datasets.publisher: Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) via BetterGov.ph
datasets.attributionText: Infrastructure project data from the official DPWH transparency platform, packaged by BetterGov.ph.
datasets.notes: Read from a 248220-row Parquet file (17 of 25 columns projected). 214747 rows carry usable coordinates; 478 fall inside Labo's bounding box, and 309 fall inside a Labo barangay polygon. 203 row(s) name Labo in the description but could not be located, so they are excluded. `location.province` is the implementing District Engineering Office, not a project location.

datasets.title: Emergency and public-safety contact numbers for Labo
datasets.publisher: Compiled from the LGU, CNPPO, BFP, DOH and the national eHotlines portal
datasets.note: 12 entries; 0 local defects and 2 upstream data defects recorded.

datasets.title: A brief history of the Municipality of Labo
datasets.publisher: Compiled from NHI/NHCP markers, the Official Gazette, PSA, the provincial government and the LGU
datasets.license: Public domain (Philippine government work) / cited third parties
datasets.note: 20 citations; 5 commonly repeated claims excluded as unsourced.

datasets.title: Municipality of Labo — news posts (WordPress REST API, via Wayback Machine)
datasets.note: 2 posts compiled, 1 excluded by the injection blocklist.

datasets.title: Municipality of Labo official website
datasets.publisher: Municipal Government of Labo, Camarines Norte
datasets.license: Public domain (per the site footer: "All content is in the public domain unless otherwise stated.")
datasets.attributionText: Municipal Government of Labo, Camarines Norte — official website (labo.gov.ph). Retrieved via the Internet Archive Wayback Machine; each section records its snapshot date.
datasets.notes: Read from Wayback captures because the live host is Cloudflare-gated. Officials capture 2026-02-01; executive names last stated 2025-05-16; legislative roster as of 2025-05-16. 20 department heads, 7 section heads, 11 legislative members. The LGU's own barangay list cross-checks 52/52 against the PSGC-compiled index.

datasets.title: Municipal Services Directory (compiled from the LGU's own Citizen's Charter PDFs)
datasets.note: 51 services across 5 categories; 26 published gaps recorded.

datasets.title: Project NOAH Hazard Maps
datasets.publisher: Project NOAH (Nationwide Operational Assessment of Hazards), DOST
datasets.attributionText: Hazard layers produced by Project NOAH, Department of Science and Technology, Philippines.
datasets.notes: Per-province shapefile archives for Camarines Norte, clipped to the Labo municipal outline with a point-in-polygon test. Analysed: flood_5yr (static, 3 features), storm_surge (none-in-area, 0 features). Not compiled: flood_25yr, flood_100yr, landslide.

datasets.title: Philippine Barangay Boundaries (Hierarchical GeoJSON)
datasets.publisher: Manuel Balmeo (PSA PSGC + NAMRIA boundary layers) via BetterGov.ph
datasets.attributionText: Boundary polygons derived from PSA Philippine Standard Geographic Code snapshots (2023-10-24) and NAMRIA administrative-boundary shapefiles (v2023-11-06), packaged by Manuel Balmeo.
datasets.notes: Selected 52 of 42026 national barangay polygons by ADM3_PCODE=PH0501606; geometry simplified at 0.0002°. Areas are the upstream AREA_SQKM values (NAMRIA-derived), not recomputed.

pendingFields.reason: No barangay-level PSA census extract is published on data.bettergov.ph. Place an official PSA Census of Population file at data/sources/psa-population.csv (headers: psgc_code,population,source,year) and re-run `npm run etl barangays` to attach it.
The AIP is published per-LGU as a PDF on the LGU website, not as a structured dataset. The FDPP explorer links to the source document instead of transcribing it.
